alignment: Unique identical IDs; exact prompt_id, true_model and fold equality after ID alignment; ordered probabilities validated

baseline.validation_scope: OOF schema/probabilities/prompt-fold consistency only; does not prove vectorizers were fit within training folds

family_diagnostics.note: Provider aggregation is diagnostic only; competition metric remains 18-class BA

candidate.validation_scope: OOF schema/probabilities/prompt-fold consistency only; does not prove vectorizers were fit within training folds

family_diagnostics.note: Provider aggregation is diagnostic only; competition metric remains 18-class BA

paired_prompt_cluster_bootstrap.method: paired percentile prompt-cluster bootstrap of fixed OOF predictions
paired_prompt_cluster_bootstrap.caveat: Approximate intervals conditional on fitted OOF models; no retraining variance. Intervals are exploratory and not multiplicity corrected. A positive bootstrap fraction is not a probability of improvement. Replicates lacking any of 18 legal classes are excluded and counted. Repeated training runs are not independent statistical evidence; these intervals do not predict leaderboard rank.

baseline.note: Rows are true classes, columns predicted classes. Rates use all true-class rows; the pair submatrix is not renormalized.

candidate.note: Rows are true classes, columns predicted classes. Rates use all true-class rows; the pair submatrix is not renormalized.

family_diagnostics_note: Provider aggregation is diagnostic; model comparisons use all 18 class recalls.

provenance_verification.threadpool_path_note: Library paths may differ; APIs, prefixes, versions, threads, threading layer and architecture must match.
